body_markdown:
**From 17 to 20 November 2026, Pentair Pool looks forward to seeing you at the Piscine Global trade show in Lyon.**


**This edition will be particularly special: Pentair is celebrating 60 years of innovation, quality and reliability in serving professionals in the swimming pool industry.**


Come and meet our teams, discover our latest innovations and discuss your projects, market trends and the solutions that are shaping the swimming pools of tomorrow.


[Request my invitation](https://pass.piscine-global.com/index.php?langue_id=2&utm_source=pentairpooleurope.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=fallback)


## Come and meet us in Lyon


Piscine Global is, above all, an opportunity to get together and take the time to exchange ideas.


Our European commercial and technical teams will be on hand throughout the show to answer your questions, discuss your projects and show you the latest products from Pentair Pool.


**Variable speed pumps, next-generation filtration, connected automation: there will be a range of new products to discover at our stand.**


And for members of the **Pentair PIP programme**


, a little surprise awaits you too...


## Would you like to visit Piscine Global?


Are you a Pentair customer or partner? Request your invitation and join us in Lyon.


We look forward to celebrating 60 years of Pentair Pool innovation with you and to continuing to build the swimming pools of tomorrow together.
